deploybot: :rotating_light: Release slot 2025.3 (slot 78) — HOLD triggered by incident INC-9257 (authz-service 503s). Scheduled window 2025-03-10T22:00Z. Auto-proceed disabled. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/INC-9257

maria: Confirming — authz still returning 503s in EU canary. Holding all rollouts and canaries.

sam: Quick question — this is a config-only feature flag and a token-cache migration. Can we still push the non-db parts?

zheng: The migration flips a DB flag. If we separate, we must ensure the migration bit stays pinned or clients will error. Rollback would require `revert_migration_db_flag` runbook.

alice: Ops recommends we do not proceed with anything touching token caching. Suggest we shift remaining non-db changes into a quick canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC (hotpatch/backstop) and pin the migration to v1.2.4 for safety.

ben: Prefer stagger: - non-db changes -> next slot if authz stabilizes <2h - db migration -> last slot or separate maintenance. Also update release notes and customer comms that migration is deferred.

maria: Sounds good. I'll open a short change-plan in the release doc and add a backstop checklist. Ops @ops can you reserve 02:00 UTC hotpatch slot? Tag it "hotpatch-backstop".

ops: Reserved hotpatch slot 2025-03-11T02:00Z (capacity: 4 zones). Tag applied: hotpatch-backstop. Please limit database-affecting changes in that slot.

sam: If authz clears in <2h we can run a narrow canary for non-db things at 2025-03-10T23:30Z. Otherwise full defer to 02:00 slot.

alice: Add to release notes: "migration_flag pinned to v1.2.4 until post-incident validation" and add a rollback playbook link.

zheng: Preparing a rollback helper: `./scripts/revert_migration.sh --dry-run` (I'll push to the release branch). Also adding a DB check list to avoid partial migrations.

maria: I'll update the release doc, add the rollback command, and ping PMs + support for comms. Action items: update release notes, schedule hotpatch slot, tag release, pin migration flag, prepare rollback script.

ben: +1. Filing follow-up: Ops to add postmortem item to investigate routing rule that caused authz spike.

sam: I'll queue the `/deploybot reschedule` command if everyone agrees. Proposed command: `/deploybot reschedule 2025.3 2025-03-11T02:00Z --tags hotpatch-backstop --disable-canaries`

deplybot_typo_fix: (typo) — ignore

deploybot: Ack. Release 2025.3 rescheduled to 2025-03-11T02:00Z. Canaries disabled. Pin added: migration_flag=v1.2.4. Hold remains until manual unhold. Refer to: https://internal/releases/2025.3 for updated notes. :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks — keeping thread open. Please post when incident cleared and when you run any backfill or hotpatch.

zheng: Will post a dry-run result once `revert_migration.sh --dry-run` completes.

ben: Closing loop: I will coordinate comms with support after we decide actual rollout time.
